meta.title: IG System v2 · Ignacio Gauna
meta.description: The tokens of Ignacio Gauna's new portfolio: colour, type, space, shape, motion and depth.

hero.leadBefore: I build software for a world with more
hero.stackAlt: The craft in five layers, in an exploded view: planning and execution, code, agents, tests and deploy
hero.stackTitle: The five layers of the craft

intro.title: The system, in its smallest pieces
intro.text: Colour, type, space, shape, motion and depth: the base of all of /v2. Every value comes from a single file and is measured before it goes in.

color.title: Colour
color.text: Deep indigo as the base and one colour for each part of the craft. IG's coral and blue are still the root of the spectrum.

type.title: Type
type.text: Archivo, with its width axis, for headings; JetBrains Mono for anything technical. No text goes below 12 px.

samples.lead: I build software for a world with more solutions than problems.
samples.body: I design and build AI products end to end: the interface, the backend, the agents and the tests.
samples.small: Every project carries its status: production, demo or prototype.
samples.label: Sr AI Fullstack Developer

space.title: Space and shape
space.text: A 4 px scale, soft radii and touch targets of at least 44 px.

motion.title: Motion
motion.text: One signature curve and three durations: response, state change and entrance. Only transform and opacity move; with reduced motion, everything stays still.
motion.hint: Switch each row on to see its curve.

depth.title: Depth
depth.text: A brand glow for the main action, panels that float over the indigo and a focus ring that always shows.

meta.title: Components · IG System v2
meta.description: The base components of Ignacio Gauna's new portfolio: buttons, chips, statuses, glass cards, forms and navigation.

intro.title: The pieces everything is built from
intro.text: Every component comes from the tokens, works with the keyboard and shows its focus. Try them here: hover, press Tab and use the arrow keys.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.text: One main action per screen, with the brand gradient; the rest are glass or text. All of them are 44 px or taller.

chips.title: Chips and labels
chips.text: Technologies, layers of the craft and keyboard shortcuts. They are information, not buttons.

status.title: Statuses
status.text: Every project says where it stands, always in positive terms: what comes next is told as the next step.

cards.title: Glass cards
cards.text: Panels that float over the indigo, in the colour of their layer. The whole card is a link and its title names it.

complia.title: CompliA
complia.text: A RAG assistant for a compliance portal: every answer comes with its citation.

eclipse.title: Eclipse
eclipse.text: Product, portal and brand: from the landing page to the backend, with tests at every layer.

volta.title: Volta
volta.text: A demo to show the product before building all of it.

supernova.title: Supernova Eventos
supernova.text: An events micro-app, from idea to demo.

panel.title: Panel
panel.text: A glass container to group content without a clickable card.

forms.title: Forms
forms.text: Labels always visible, hints below and errors that say how to go on. All native: it works with the keyboard and with screen readers.
forms.sample: A sample of the components: this form sends no messages.

name.label: Name
name.hint: However you'd like me to call you.

email.label: Email
email.error: Write a full email, for example name@company.com.

message.label: Message
message.hint: Tell me the challenge in two or three lines.

forms.copy: Send me a copy of the message

nav.title: Navigation
nav.text: Tabs in the colour of each section, breadcrumb, previous and next, and text that unfolds.
nav.body: The question reaches the assistant, which searches the documents, drafts an answer and checks it against its sources before replying.
